about: Every DNS record of the three AgentiCCells zones, as data. One object per record set. "observed" is the date the record was seen live with public lookups (DNS-over-HTTPS); "planned" means not live yet. Zone status "parked" means not in use: checked for information only. Checked by dns/check.mjs. Kept by dns@agenticcells.dinis; applied only by Dinis, or by an agent with credentials scoped to these zones.
source: dns/ROUTE53.md; observed 2026-11-15 by dns@agenticcells.dinis with dns.google and cloudflare-dns.com; re-observed 2026-11-15 (after 20:08 UTC) by dns@AgentiCCells.dinis, same lookups plus curl

zones.use: Served the company site until about 18:15 UTC on 2026-11-15, when the site moved to agenticcells.ai (Dinis: "ok, domain agenticcells.ai is now pointed to the site"). Still points at GitHub Pages, but no repository claims it: https and http answer 404 "Site not found", so any GitHub account could claim it (board/ACC-018.md). Nothing is changed until Dinis decides.

http.note: GitHub Pages "Site not found" while unclaimed

zones.use: Customer sites, one CNAME per customer label (dns/CUSTOMER-SITES.md). No apex site.
zones.note: On 2026-11-15 the .app registry answered NXDOMAIN for agenticcells.app: the domain is not delegated to any nameservers yet.

zones.use: The company site, served by GitHub Pages from AgentiCCells/AgentiCCells__Website. Dinis, 2026-11-15 ~18:15: "ok, domain agenticcells.ai is now pointed to the site". Earlier ("not going to use it until the NS stabelise") is superseded.
